about.title: About THEFOLDER
about.section1:
THEFOLDER was born as a response to the lack of visibility faced by creatives when they finish their studies.
Every year, projects with enormous creative value are generated that, due to lack of dissemination or connections, never get discovered, promoted, or recognized by the industry. Many are relegated to a profile with few followers, a final project that never leaves the classroom, or a fashion show with limited coverage.
about.section2:
Here, your profile becomes your professional folder. A platform connected directly with the industry, where uploading an image means presenting it to the professional world, without intermediaries or algorithms limiting your reach.

At THEFOLDER, talent is celebrated, projected, and connected with the professional sector, in an environment designed especially for fashion and emerging design.
about.howText: A unique space that brings together portfolios, CVs, job and educational offers, with advanced tools to filter talent and opportunities.
about.whyText: Because emerging talent in fashion and design deserves a real opportunity to project themselves towards the industry, without depending on algorithms, contacts, or location.
about.photoCredit: Photographs by @manel.png

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailDescription: For general inquiries, technical support, and collaborations.
contact.aboutText1: TheFolderWorld is a digital platform designed to connect creatives with other creatives, industry professionals, and educational institutions within the fashion field. Our goal is to create a space where emerging talents can showcase their work, connect with professional and educational opportunities, and be part of a vibrant community of creatives.
contact.aboutText2: Founded in 2025 by Miriam Reina Bolaños, TheFolderWorld was born from the need to create a specialized meeting point for the fashion and design sector, with a focus on the visibility of new talents and the connection between different actors in the industry.
